summary.text: Kristan Tilton is the Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Cheshire 12, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where she faces incumbent Republican Dick Thackston.

paragraphs.text: Tilton advanced from the Democratic primary for Cheshire 12 on September 8, 2026.
She was previously the Democratic candidate in Cheshire 17 in 2024, when incumbent Jennifer Rhodes defeated her in the general election.
